text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — Canary deploy showing sudden latency/throughput regression on canary-quant-4. P99 spike, throughput drop. Paging #eng-oncall.

emma: I'm on call, joining. Pulling dashboards now.

raj: seeing kernel fallback spikes on the canary hosts. kernel_fallback rate ~18% over last 5m. batch window increased to ~150ms.

dave: verified on metrics: rps down ~30%, p99 from ~120ms -> ~1.1s. tail latency and CPU kernel switches correlate.

emma: rollout id = release/2024-05-25/quant-rollout-3. Feature flag `v1_quant_serve` enabled for canary.

marta: CS: getting a handful of tickets about slow inference responses, no widespread outages reported yet.

raj: logs (sample):
```
[2024-05-25T14:02:12Z] kernel_fallback: reason=matmul_timeout shard=3 exec=cpu_executor
[2024-05-25T14:02:13Z] batcher: window_ms=152 batch_size=8
```

dave: looks like quantized kernel selector is timing out and falling back to CPU path under canary batching patterns. Could be an interaction between new quant kernel and our batching heuristics.

emma: can we flip the feature flag on canary only to isolate? Who can toggle now?

dave: ops: `releasesctl rollback-flag --env canary v1_quant_serve false` should do it.

oncall-bot: Command received: toggling feature flag v1_quant_serve -> false on env=canary.

oncall-bot: Feature flag updated at 2024-05-25T14:12:03Z.

dave: monitoring... metrics?

raj: p95 dropped to ~220ms within 3m, p99 trending down. kernel_fallback now ~2%. throughput recovering.

marta: CS: ticket rate reduced, customers on initial watchlist reporting improvement.

emma: decision point: do we rollback the entire release or re-enable with different kernel fallback? Ops suggests rollback the canary rollout and pause.

dave: propose staged rollback: revert canary only and hold stable rollout. Starting rollback: `deployctl rollback release/2024-05-25/quant-rollout-3 --target canary`

oncall-bot: Rollback job queued and started.

raj: archiving relevant logs/metrics for postmortem: s3://redwood-incident/1719004321/logs.tar.gz

emma: handing off to next shift in 10m. @oliver you're primary for watch.

oliver: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and kick off incident write-up.

marta: drafting customer-impact note: "Some customers experienced increased latency during canary deploy; mitigated by disabling quant feature flag on canary; no data loss reported."

dave: RCA placeholder: quant kernel selector + batcher race causing matmul timeouts -> kernel fallback -> throughput drop. Need more unit/integration tests and a gating check on kernel timeouts.

emma: thanks team. Will close thread once rollback fully completes and metrics stable for 30m. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Rollback completed at 2024-05-25T14:33:22Z. Canary returned to baseline.

oliver: verified p99 ~130ms, rps back to expected. Marking incident mitigated and handing to postmortem.

emma: filing incident report with timeline and action items. Good catch everyone.
